summary: The Удалить assertion checks a hard-coded disabled attribute with no state feeding it, so it can only fail if the button is enabled; it locks in a placeholder instead of quarantine behaviour
evidence: VirusesPage.test.ts:73; VirusesPage.svelte:158 static disabled with title Карантин — следующий шаг; FND-0099
failure_scenario: The change that implements quarantine selection would fail this test without protecting any behaviour.
